description:
Rollup for Group A: the direct replacement of the repository mutation architecture. One dependency-ordered sequence on main replaced declarations, capture, materialization, managed documents, typed serialization/audit, storage publication, every repository-owned mutation consumer, and every predecessor path.

## Background

The repository-materialization consolidation was delivered as bounded final-form waves directly on main under the invoker-approved delivery model, followed by one independently gated integration leaf that reviewed the combined architecture. This story groups that Group A work and asserts the discipline that kept each wave final-form while preserving one coherent product transition.

## What to build

- The complete Group A outcome: final declaration owners; canonical layout/image/capture with physical-identity uniqueness; pinned and linked-worktree evidence; typed intents/deltas; the strict managed-document engine; the layout-aware recovered store, kernel, staged absent-root publication, and `DeleteFile`; typed mutation, exact lifecycle time/ID authority, and canonical audit append; claim's repository-side synchronization under coordinator → bootstrap → repository → events; the materializers, drift, and ownership-safe repair; and the full consumer migration with every predecessor deleted.
- Enforce the direct-main delivery discipline: work packages land in dependency order as final-form, independently reviewed changes; predecessor deletion completes before the integration checkpoint; neither integration nor assurance defers cleanup.

Distilled §2 contracts: research-to-final vocabulary and direct final-form execution. See `dev/active/cdc840ad-plan.md` §2, §3 (Group A), and §4. The invoker-approved direct-main delivery model supersedes the plan's retired integration-branch staging mechanics while preserving its final-form and no-compatibility constraints.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Group A packages land directly on main in dependency order as final-form changes; the final integration leaf is the holistic review and gate checkpoint for the combined product transition.
- [hard] REQ-02: Every Group A package passes the relevant workspace tests and review gates before its dependent wave begins; all predecessor deletion completes before the final integration checkpoint; no cleanup is deferred past that checkpoint.

## Constraints

- Direct-to-main dependency waves; final-form commits only; the retired `integration/cdc840ad` branch is not an authority and must not be recreated.
- No adapter, feature flag, compatibility re-export, dual path, or temporary API is introduced at any staging step.
- Out of scope (plan D19/D20): lease credential/claim-log/claim-command redesign and worktree/data-root binding redesign.

Blast radius: the complete declarations/repository_state/validation/profile/storage/command/CLI/server/MCP/script/test inventory in §2.
